title: Changing Society
description: Changing Society offers a foundational exploration of the causes, impacts, and dynamics of social change. Informed by the tenets of universal design, equity and belonging, and a commitment to a decolonizing approach, it is written for undergraduate students majoring in social sciences, social work, ethnic studies, or social justice studies.
authors: Aimee Samara Krouskop - Author / Ben Cushing - Author / Kimberly Puttman - Author / Avery Temple - Author
